contract.features: sqrt spikes; log1p positive/negative voltage area; normalized to 500 ms

selection: Train selects features/weights; validation selects thresholds and per-label qualification; saved before opening test.

extension.seed_mismatch_note: Differs only in the RNG seed of the base episode; the reused rows keep the seeds they were collected with, and no base episode is regenerated.
extension.scope: Every base episode keeps its id, split, condition, turns and environment in the extension protocol; a union fit may mix exactly these two protocol revisions, and each row keeps the hash of its own run.

limitations: Some conditions occupy only one session per split.
Persistent windows within a session are correlated, not independent replicates.
Lateralized population delivery is not spatial object localization.
No natural-language intent or behavior target is fitted.
A nominal unilateral scene can become bilateral or silent as the free body moves; planned side is never a target.
Tap timing and emitter field strengths are engineering parameter sets; the sources are not calibrated concentrations or sound pressures.

The plume is upstream data from a different arena scale; it is not a cVA concentration. The following source is a different physical claim from a fixed source and is labelled as such. Nudge trains are engineering timings, and no direction code is claimed for them.
A following source can still become bilateral if the two antennae come within its declared range; delivered events, never the planned side, decide labels.
No held-out test failure is retuned away in this run.
Whole-brain dynamics, receptor transduction and motor behavior are not calibrated by this classifier.
